narr: During the afternoon and into the evening, a line of strong thunderstorms developed in northwest Kansas and moved slowly north across parts of extreme southwest Nebraska where it dissipated. Heavy rainfall in the Stratton area caused a culvert and portions of a county road to be washed out.
ev: Heavy rain produced flash flooding, washing out a culvert and portions of County Road 714 along a creek.
lsr: WATER WASHED OUT A CULVERT AND ROAD ALONG A CREEK BETWEEN COUNTY ROADS 714AND 352.
